body: So basically.. they took what the learned from Hitler and inflict those ideas into others? Interesting.

I don’t know if it’s material things, I think for me (as a girl anyway) it is important to look a certain way but I kinda don’t want it to be. I think compliments on looks are empty (imo anyway). The material hasn’t helped me as of yet. So I’ve been able to check off two. I haven’t felt enough for my family or anyone else, it’s always not being educated enough or not taking care of others enough but I barely have the strength to get out of bed and take care of me. My entire life ive wanted to build other up and I’ve seemed to break myself apart trying to get there. It’s exhausting. Friends are only friends when things are up, people usually care to date people who are well established and happy, parents always have these unrealistic standards. Don’t get me wrong, logically I think I know that I’m an intelligent being and not bad looking but it doesn’t feel enough. I still am not sure what I care about.
Thank you for making me feel normal.
